criterion: 滿載加入新事件後仍不超出容量、最舊待送事件被移除、保留順序與覆寫數可驗證；必要保護仍完成，消費者持有資料不被覆寫。
method: Model-assisted source/document review plus executable host regressions
finding: Reviewed rule/design contract case. Compliant example: With queue capacity 2, pending events A/B then C retain B/C and increment overwrite count. A borrowed event uses separate owned storage. Required finding for the counterexample: Overwriting the consumer's borrowed bytes violates ERR-QUEUE-001 and MEM-LIFE-001.
limits: Rule/design governance acceptance; target runtime claims require separate project evidence.
